correctness.rationale: One-generated Zinbiel products imply every algebra automorphism is substitution e1 -> a e1+b e2+c e3+d e4 (a≠0), with triangular diagonal a,a²,a³,a⁴. Restriction to W=<e2,e3,e4> is (x,y,z)->(a²x,3abx+a³y,(4ac+3b²)x+6a²by+a⁴z). Split x≠0, x=0 y≠0 and x=y=0 z≠0. When p>=5, elimination yields two square classes for x≠0, gcd(3,q−1) cube classes, gcd(4,q−1) fourth classes plus zero and outside W. In p=2, x≠0 invariant delta=(xz+y²)/x³ gives q orbits, and on x=0,yz≠0 eta=y⁴/z³ gives q−1. In p=3, x≠0 y≠0 theta=y²/x³ yields q−1 plus two y=0 square classes, and x=0 yz≠0 gives q−1. Independent orbit enumeration using distinct direct matrix actions matched totals p/q=2/2:7,3/3:11,5/5:9,7/7:9,11/11:7. Power-class counts use finite fields; not a statement about semilinear automorphisms.
